certain directions with regard to the 
regularization proposal of the petitioners. The 
Court had further directed the State 
Government to take a decision and apprise to 
this Court by way of an affidavit. It has not 
been filed. Although, learned counsel 
appearing for the Forest Corporation would 
submit that the State Government has 
declined the claim for regularizations of the 
petitioners by communication dated 
24.04.2025. 
Let State file short affidavit to this effect
within a week.

be filed.
List thereafter.

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No. 1564 of 2021 
WPSS No. 1755 of 2022
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. T.A. Khan, learned Sr. Advocate (through V.C.) 
assisted Mr. Mohd. Shafy, learned counsel for the 
petitioners.
2. Mr. V.K. Kaparwan, learned counsel for the 
respondents / Uttarakhan Forest Development 
Corporation. 
3. Mr. Tarun Mohan, learned Brief Holder for the State.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that twice 
the proposal were sent to the Government by the Forest 
Development Corporation for seeking approval for 
regularization of the petitioners but on both occasions the 
Government declined to give approval. 
5. Admittedly, Uttarakhand Forest Development 
Corporation is not funded by the State Government and 
these petitioners are working since 1985 though for certain 
period they were retrenched, however, since 2007 they are
working regularly without break. 
6. List on 15.12.2025.
7. By that time the State Counsel may get instructions 
from the concerned Secretary, to this effect that if the Forest 
Development Corporation is not funded by the State 
Government, then why State declined to give approval for 
regularization of the petitioners. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 08.12.2025
SKS

WPSS No. 1755 of 2022
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. T.A. Khan, learned senior counsel assisted by 
Mr. Mohd. Shafy, learned counsel for the petitioners 
through V.C.
2. Mr. Pradeep Hairiya, learned Standing Counsel 
for the State.
3. Mr. V.K. Kaparuwan, learned counsel for the 
respondent/Uttarakhand Forest Development 
Corporation.
4. Mr. Jagat S. Mehra, learned counsel holding the 
brief of Ms. Devika Tiwari, learned counsel for 
respondent no. 4.
5. The Uttarakhand Development Forest 
Corporation is admittedly a self funded corporation, 
however there is a requirement to get approval from 
the Government.
6. On the previous date a specific question was 
asked from the State if the corporation is not funded by 
the State Government and the Corporation sent the 
requisition to the State Government for seeking 
approval for regularization of the petitioners then why 
the respondent/State is declining to give their 
approval.
7. Let the Mr. Harigovind may get instructions by 
18.12.2025.
8. List this matter on 18.12.2025.
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 16.12.2025
